title: AXe command result, schema version 1
description: The envelope a command without --agent returns with --output json, and an --agent invocation that ends without an agent result, such as --help. A successful command's data.result is described per command in axe.output.command-payloads.v1.schema.json. Fields can be added within a schema version, so consumers should ignore properties they do not know.

command.description: The full command path without axe, for example tap, hinge set or settings status-bar show. A command line that does not parse reports the command words it spells out, or its first word.

error.description: Present exactly when didError is true. Branch on code; the message can change in any release.

code.description: A lowerCamelCase code, such as invalidArguments, targetNotFound, notBooted or busy.

results.description: The command's payloads, in output order, when it wrote more than one.

nextSteps.description: Reserved for guidance. Ordinary commands currently return an empty array.
